 Ripple Transfers 120 Million XRP to Anonymous Wallet
 Published 3:40 AM Oct 30, 2026 Source Uk Jin 
 Ripple has transferred a large amount of XRP.
 Whale Alert said on October 30 that 120 million XRP was moved from a Ripple address to an anonymous wallet about five minutes earlier.
 The transfer was worth about $150 million at current prices.
